name: Visual Delta Patch Policy
patchRules: group defects by root cause before mutation
patch the smallest node set that fixes the root cause
reject patches outside the active Mutation Budget
verify protected siblings after every patch batch
P0/P1 remain blocking until VERIFIED or explicitly BLOCKED
P2 may remain only when final policy allows polish gaps; current final state still follows parent QA rules
forbidden: full redraft for a local delta without structural root-cause evidence
treating screenshot similarity as component-identity proof
